snippet.title: Sunken Sky - Story Trailer
snippet.description:
The official Sunken Sky trailer for 2026

Steampage: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2063020/Sunken_Sky/
Homepage: https://sunkensky.com/
 
Join our unlikely protagonists in their adventure. Nameless girl seeking to traverse across the kingdoms. A survivor driven by guilt. A noble with too much to prove. Their paths will cross and, perhaps, so will their goals. 

Sunken Sky is a metroidvania mixed with a hefty dose of JRPG elements. It's a (mostly) lighthearted story of self-development, hope and discovery. But it hasn't always been that way and this animation shows a glimpse into it's world.
